title: Memory Fabric/XTP continuation and outstanding qualification
summary: Candidate2 is an additive memory-fabric.xtp-transfer/0.1 engineering increment; it has not established live distributed block-page transfer or authenticated multicast memory services.
invariants: Rebase the candidate against accepted Memory Fabric and XTP revisions; do not silently replace Memory Fabric dev10 or claim that candidate submission means acceptance.
Qualify named-service FIRST ingress with cryptographic identity/ACL, block-specific authority proof and replay-resistant lease/epoch checks before live remote mutation.

Implement explicit service multicast mapping for memory.block.locate and memory.block.invalidate: scoped membership, bounded response population, duplicate suppression, repair/rejoin, independently authorized operations.
Integrate portable job/admission placement and optional native block transfer with verifiable bytes, checksums, expiry and fencing; do not create a new transport selector.
Qualify true receiver-side shared capacity accounting and two concurrent named-service contexts under emergency, rate-zero and path-failover cases.
Test machine-to-machine ED209 L2/raw36/UDP routes with exact route, policy and failure-domain evidence before calling transport deployment qualified.
Keep Memory Fabric, Gopher sphere, and XTP packages independently importable and version-pin dependencies.

Read-side ingress must bind an independently authenticated caller to an authoritative service and current owner/ACL; MemoryXtpReadIngress permits are read-only and do not replace page-data, durable replay, or real capacity enforcement.
Fail closed if the transport proof resolves to different authenticated principals while admission is in progress.

provenance.claim: Documents named-service live capacity and context-key regression scope.
Reference range-splitting model and boundary warning.
